verdict.rationale: Brex markets AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments as part of its bill pay offering. Its Payments API manages vendors and sends ACH, domestic wire, and check payments, and the MCP server can track bills, so the upload-to-approve-to-pay flow is claimed end to end. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on bill upload and on configuring approval workflows (approver chains, rules), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the approval routing works before payment.
